configurePresets.name: win
configurePresets.displayName: Windows MSVC (Ninja, Release, TLS via vcpkg OpenSSL)
configurePresets.description: Day-to-day Windows dev build. Run inside a VsDevCmd x64 shell (cl/ml64/INCLUDE injected). OpenSSL is picked up from vcpkg so io-08 TLS builds without passing -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR each time: set the OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR env var to override, else the repo-convention path C:/public/vcpkg/installed/x64-windows is used. If OpenSSL isn't installed there, TLS just isn't compiled (opt-in dependency).

configurePresets.name: wsl
configurePresets.description: Day-to-day Linux dev build. GCC 14 (the CMake toolchain gate rejects the distro-default gcc-13). TLS is found zero-config from the system libssl-dev. NOTE the 9p rule: run heavy IO / stress / bench from a native-ext4 clone (e.g. /root/hyle), never from /mnt/c.

configurePresets.name: wsl-tsan
configurePresets.description: TSan build for lock-free / concurrency work (MANDATORY before landing such changes). Run the test exes under `setarch -R` to disable ASLR for stable TSan. Separate binary dir so it never shares a cache with the plain Release build.

configurePresets.name: bench
configurePresets.description: Release + microbenchmarks in an isolated build-bench cache. SIMD benches require the pinned external Highway/xsimd checkouts selected by HYLE_BENCH_VENDOR_DIR; run scripts/fetch-bench-vendors.{sh,ps1} first. On Linux/WSL, invoke this generic preset with CC=gcc-14 CXX=g++-14.

configurePresets.name: bench-all-sota
configurePresets.displayName: benchmarks + ALL gated SOTA rivals (DEV-ONLY, not a product build)
configurePresets.description: DEV/BENCH-ONLY one-shot: flips every -DHYLE_BENCH_* gate ON so each bench races its real SOTA rival (not just std). These HYLE_BENCH_* gates are a SEPARATE category from the product build params (HYLE_STATIC/SANITIZER/WERROR/ISA tier) -- they ONLY add comparison rows to the benchmarks and NEVER affect the shipped library. Fetch pinned Highway/xsimd first with scripts/fetch-bench-vendors.{sh,ps1}; clone the other gated rivals (absl/tbb/marl/moodycamel/rigtorp/boost) with scripts/setup-bench-libs.sh (boost::intrusive needs the boost submodule checked out). simdutf remains vendored. Vectorized exp/log/tanh + utf8 are already unconditional in the product build (no flag).
